record.question: The incomming solar radiation from the sun which is received in short wave is known as:
record.explanation: Answer A: Insolation. Incoming short-wave solar radiation is termed insolation. Reference: https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/solar-radiation/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
